title: Landlord won't return my security deposit
triggers: deposit wapas nahi kar raha makaan malik
moved out but no refund of advance

rights.plain_explanation: If your landlord breaks the rent agreement by keeping your deposit without reason, you can claim the money and compensation for the loss it causes.

do_now: Find your rent agreement and check what it says about the deposit and deductions.
Ask the landlord in writing (WhatsApp or email is fine) for the refund, with a clear deadline.
Collect proof: payment receipts, move-out photos, key handover messages.
If they claim damage, ask for an itemised list with bills.
user_at_fault_cases: Unpaid rent, unpaid bills or real damage beyond normal wear can be lawfully deducted if the agreement allows it.

escalation.label: Legal notice
escalation.detail: A written legal notice (free through legal aid) often settles it.

escalation.label: Rent authority or civil court
escalation.detail: Depending on your state, file with the Rent Authority or the civil court for a money claim.

escalation.label: Free legal aid
escalation.detail: Call NALSA on 15100 or visit your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) at the district court. Women, children, people in custody and people below the income limit get a free lawyer.

notes: There's no single national rule on deposit refunds; state rent laws and your agreement decide the details.
